content:
alex: Heads up — Orion partner just flagged a customs hold on a container destined for our EU rack build. ETA slipped ~10 days. This is the shipment that backs next-week marketplace go‑live and the SI pilot.

maria: Ugh. Which SKUs/POs are in that container?

logistics-bot: Update: Container CNL-8721 flagged at Rotterdam customs for documentation review. Contents: 120 x racked-GPU-units, 24 x control panels. POs: `PO-93521, PO-93522, PO-93523`. Current status: HOLD.

jon: If it's docs, we can probably clear with broker and a small fee. Who's broker on this lane?

alex: Broker is VanDerMeer Logistics (contact: paul@vandermear.com). Orion says docs were submitted but customs queried certificate of origin for a few boards. Orion is pulling paperwork now.

rachel: Timeline impact on go‑live? Marketing already queued the announcement for Tue. We can delay the public announcement, but the SI pilot will need hardware.

kevin: For Dedicated customers we've promised committed capacity for April. If that capacity goes missing it'll hit revenue and SLAs. Need contingency allocation asap.

maria: Options: 1) Ask Orion for expedited docs (fastest, but uncertain). 2) Split shipments: release available racks (if customs allows partial release). 3) Borrow inventory from APAC reserved pool (costly but keeps commitments). 4) Push marketplace launch by 1 week and coordinate credits.

jon: Ops feasibility: we can attempt crossdock in NL and pull serials for SI pilot if customs allows inspection. I'll ping ops now.

alex: Action items:
- alex: confirm exact serial SKUs + whether partial release is allowed (ETA 2h).
- jon: check crossdock/partial-release with EU ops & broker, estimate hours/cost (ETA 3h).
- maria: run contract check for marketplace & dedicated commit credits with legal (ETA EOD).
- rachel: draft two announcement variants (go/no-go) and a short customer note for SI partners (ETA EOD).

rachel: Also flagging comms: if we borrow APAC inventory, we need to coordinate firmware parity and region config — engineering must confirm ops can swap images without delays.

kevin: If we pull from APAC, finance needs a quick delta approval for expedited transport. I can pre-approve up to $25k; beyond that we need exec sign-off.

logistics-bot: Broker contact attempted: paul@vandermear.com responded — "we have a customs query open; Orion to provide certs within 4 hours or we escalate for provisional release."

jon: Quick note — rerouting a full rack via air from APAC looks like 72h min and ~$18k per rack. Crossdock partial release looks more promising if customs allows.

maria: Legal: if go‑live is delayed we should prepare a standardized credit statement. I'll draft a short T&C addendum for marketplace customers.

alex: I'll post an update once Orion confirms docs. If they can’t resolve in 4h we'll escalate to plan B (APAC borrow).

rachel: Thanks — I'll hold marketing assets on draft. If we decide to push announcement I'll need final line by EOD.

jon: Ops will test crossdock path and reply with feasibility + timeline in 3h.

logistics-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours or on broker confirmation (whichever comes first). :truck: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
